description: Top up the CURRENT org's credit wallet. Body { plan: "credit_pack_10"|"credit_pack_30"|"credit_pack_100" } → returns { url }: a hosted Stripe checkout page to open in a browser and confirm payment. There are no subscription tiers — a pack is a one-off top-up, and it is also the only thing that raises the generation (premium_credits) allowance. Always a URL — an existing saved card is NEVER charged silently; the human confirms on Stripe. The org is resolved from your key, never the body. Requires the billing:write scope. Only send a user here when get_account shows the relevant `balance` at or near zero. Discover the packs with list_plans.

commandId.description: Retry identity. A call repeated with the same commandId returns the first result instead of acting twice.

name: create_checkout

url.description: Hosted Stripe checkout URL to open in a browser to complete payment. Always present on success — an existing saved card is never charged without confirming here.

title: Create Checkout
